product: Session restore for serverless jobs is in Public Preview
tagline: Restore the Python variables and Spark session from a serverless compute job run into a new interactive notebook, so you can debug a failure or explore results without rerunning the entire job.
what_it_does: Restore the Python variables and Spark session from a serverless compute job run into a new interactive notebook, so you can debug a failure or explore results without rerunning the entire job. Databricks captures the snapshot automatically for eligible runs. You can create and manage notebook jobs directly in the notebook UI.
why_it_matters: If you use serverless, select the performance mode.
